responsibility: Implements Solaris-specific C-family frontend support. It defines the Solaris-only cmn_err format checker tables used by GCC format diagnostics, parses and registers Solaris pragmas such as #pragma align, #pragma init, and #pragma fini, and records pending pragma-driven attributes for later attachment to declarations. This file is the frontend-facing Solaris companion that handles source-language pragmas and diagnostics, not the lower-level assembly/output helpers in sol2.c.
